proposition: According to the colophon on MS Majlis 10196 f. 330a, Sharḥ Fuṣūṣ al-Ḥikam was finished on 20 Ṣafar 814 (13 June 1411) and corrected in Fars on 19 Dhū l-Ḥijja 817 (1 March 1415); here the colophon itself states completion and correction, and no asterisk is printed.

mediation.who: copyist(s) of MS Majlis 10196, as reported by Melvin-Koushki citing Ḥāʾirī's catalogue
mediation.note: the colophon itself records completion and correction, not just copying
